				...((grps ?? []).slice(0, 60).map((g) => Row({
					title: (String(g.name ?? "") === "" ? "（没名字的群）" : String(g.name)) + (g.chatted === true ? " · 聊过" : ""),
					desc: "群 id " + g.id + (String(g.note ?? "") === "" ? " · 还没写群设定" : " · 群设定已写"),
					stack: true
				},
					h("div", { className: "fs-row", style: { gap: "8px", alignItems: "center" } },

						Button({

							onClick: () => setNoteOpen(noteOpen === groupKey(g.id) ? "" : groupKey(g.id))
						}, noteOpen === groupKey(g.id) ? "收起群设定" : (String(g.note ?? "") === "" ? "写群设定" : "改群设定"))),
					noteOpen === groupKey(g.id)
						? h(Area, {
							key: "note:" + groupKey(g.id) + ":" + String(g.note ?? "").length,
							defaultValue: String(g.note ?? ""),
							rows: 3,
							maxLength: 500,
							disabled: noteBusy,
